summary: Altero is a self-hosted Zotero sync server with a web UI. Five saved views: (1) library – My Library workspace with collection tree, group libraries, tag selector and item list; (2) item-detail – same workspace with a journal article selected, showing the item pane with editable metadata, creators and abstract; (3) group-settings – Coastal Ecology Lab management page (name/description form, permission selects, recent activity); (4) settings-profile – settings area with section sidebar and profile form/public page radio options; (5) notifications – invitation card with Accept/Decline plus read/unread activity feed. Not saved: admin pages (overview/accounts), which use the same sidebar+cards layout as settings, and the plain groups list (simple card list).
